verses.text: The LORD said to Job:
"Will the one who argues with the Almighty correct him? Let the one who accuses God answer him!"
Then Job answered the LORD:
"I am nothing. How can I answer you? I put my hand over my mouth.
I spoke once, but I have no answer. I spoke twice, but I will say no more."
Then the LORD answered Job out of the storm:
"Get ready like a man. I will ask you questions, and you will answer me.
Would you say my judgment is wrong? Would you blame me to prove that you are right?
Do you have an arm as strong as God's? Can your voice thunder like his?
Then dress yourself in glory and splendor. Clothe yourself with honor and majesty.
Let loose your fierce anger. Look at everyone who is proud and bring them down.
Look at everyone who is proud and humble them. Crush the wicked where they stand.
Bury them all together in the dust. Shut them up in the grave.
Then I myself will admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
Look at Behemoth, which I made just as I made you. It eats grass like an ox.
Look at the strength in its hips, the power in the muscles of its belly.
Its tail sways like a cedar tree. The muscles of its thighs are tightly woven together.
Its bones are like tubes of bronze. Its legs are like bars of iron.
It is the greatest of the animals God made. Only its Maker can come near it with a sword.
The hills bring it food, where all the wild animals play.
It lies under the lotus plants, hidden among the reeds in the marsh.
The lotus plants cover it with their shade. The willows by the stream surround it.
If the river rages, it is not afraid. It stays calm even if the Jordan River rushes up to its mouth.
Can anyone capture it while it is watching, or trap it and put a ring through its nose?
